routes.fit_reason: Transaction-based monitored working capital can finance costs of projects/contracts earlier in sales cycle. WCP general guidance includes at least one year history and accurate financials, A/R and A/P agings and inventory reports; Contract CAPLine supports allocated contract overhead/G&A.
routes.blockers: Requires SBA eligible operating business, qualifying transaction/contract, lender underwriting, monitoring and repayment. A contingent assignment-fee program is not automatically an acceptable contract. Passive developer/landlord, financial-lending and speculative activity exclusions require lender review of 101XVC's substantive model.
routes.evidence: Official SBA working-capital and lender guidance; federal exclusions must be reviewed against actual business activity.
